title: Flow tests never show recovery after 51 of 53 rendered errors (config, options, reconfigure)
claim: Of the 53 distinct (flow, step, error) triples that tests/config_flow_steps.py makes the flows render, 51 never appear in a flow that later finishes, and 49 never appear in a flow that even moves past the erroring page. Reauthentication (2 of 2) is the only kind tested to recovery. config-flow-test-coverage (Bronze) requires that after each error 'the test fixes the cause and finishes the flow' for the user, reconfigure, reauthentication and options flows.
mechanism: Each error branch is exercised on its own fresh flow (fresh_flow / fresh_options) that is dropped after the error assertion. Only the reauth test resubmits the same flow and finishes it (reauth_successful). So the row's done rests on statement coverage (config_flow_percent_floor 100.0) and does not show the recovery the rule asks for.

evidence.unit: error triples (of 53) with no finishing flow; never_stepped_past=49 (config 15, options 32, reconfigure 2)
evidence.machine: macOS arm64 8-core (box B1, local), venv-ci Python 3.14.7
evidence.contention_note: box shared; count is contention-immune. The suite itself printed '5 of 585 checks FAILED' in this tree (see D10-s1-04); the triples are counted from what the flows rendered either way

instrumented_symbol: config_flow:HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow and config_flow:HeatPumpOptimizerOptionsFlow (async_show_form / async_show_menu / async_create_entry / async_abort, wrapped per instance)

perturbation.change: --perturb: after the suite, one recovery walk per unrecovered config/user error (the same flow resubmitted with a valid answer and finished)

metric_definition: Count of (flow kind, step, error) triples the flow suite renders with no flow instance that later finishes (entry created, or reauth/reconfigure success abort).
phenomenon_property: For every error a flow can render, the suite drives at least one flow from that error to completion on the same flow instance.

null_control.note: the tracker does count a recovery when the suite tests one, so the zeros are absent tests, not a blind instrument

proposed_fix_scope: tests/config_flow_steps.py: for each error branch, continue the same flow with the corrected answer to create_entry (config), reconfigure_successful (reconfigure), or a saved page and closed dialog (options). No production change.
